findings.title: Body overstates the green Actions job count: it says 14, but there are 13
findings.evidence: PR body, acceptance list line 49: "Hosted GitHub Actions checks at `f9348a2` are green (14 Actions jobs including the aggregate `ci`, plus Vercel ...)". get_check_runs at f9348a2 returns 16 check runs. 12 are jobs in CI run 37556681418 (ci, test, browser-test, lint, typecheck, build, verify-worker, extraction-gate, capability-sql, retention-sql, free-quote-sql, ovd420-recovery-egress-network). 1 is the staged SQL proof (run 37556681278). With Vercel Preview Comments and the 2 SonarCloud checks that makes 16, so there are 13 Actions jobs. The body's own hosted-checks table lists exactly 13 Actions rows. Readiness comment 6029907690 repeats "all 14 Actions jobs". The hosted results are correct; only the count is wrong, and it inflates the passing evidence by one job.
findings.suggested_fix: Edit the body text only: change it to "13 Actions jobs (12 in CI run 37556681418, including the aggregate `ci`, plus the staged SQL proof), plus Vercel". Optionally correct readiness comment 6029907690 the same way with an update to that comment, not a new post.

findings.title: The 'Migration notes' paragraph misstates the schema impact of 127-139: it names one new table set (135), but four migrations create 14 private tables, and 127 drops an RLS policy
findings.evidence: PR body, Migration notes: "All are additive: grants, private helpers, guarded `create or replace` restatements, new functions and one new table set (135)." At f9348a2, counting `create table` per migration: 129 = 5 tables (private.capability_runtime_revisions/_windows, capability_attention_state/_outbox/_evaluations), 130 = 3 (private.capability_claim/completion/attention_preparations), 131 = 3 (private.free_quote_policies, free_quote_buckets, quote_access_admissions), 135 = 3. All 14 have ENABLE + FORCE row level security, so this is not a security defect. 127 (20261002041305_enforce_quote_selection_expiry.sql:217) runs `drop policy if exists "client_selections_insert_members" on public.client_selections`. 128 (20261002053133...:5-6) revokes UPDATE from service_role. This release PR is the owner's input for the production apply, so its own summary of the migration impact contradicts the code.
findings.suggested_fix: Text-only body edit. Example: "All are forward-only and drop no data. They add 14 private forced-RLS tables (129: 5, 130: 3, 131: 3, 135: 3), new SECURITY DEFINER functions pinned to search_path pg_catalog (except the three noted under Follow-up), guarded restatements, and grant tightening (127 replaces the client_selections member-insert policy with the guarded RPC; 128 and 134 revoke privileges)." Re-run node scripts/validate-pr-body.mjs.
